evidence: The surface morphology of the modified ALD RuO2 films was examined using AFM. The root mean square (rms) roughness increased slightly with the film thickness and ranged from 12 to 20 Å. Specifically, the RMS roughness was 20 Å at a film thickness of about 400 Å, which implies that the RuO2 films deposited using modified ALD are very smooth.
